html:
Our Lady of Kibeho is the name given to apparitions of the Virgin Mary reported by schoolgirls at a Catholic school in Kibeho, southern Rwanda, beginning on 28 November 1981.

The first seer, Alphonsine Mumureke, was followed by others, and crowds came to watch them in trance. Some said the Virgin had shown them rivers of blood and bodies, which many later read as a warning of the genocide.

In 2001 the local bishop, with the approval of the Vatican, declared the visions of three of the girls authentic, the only such approval in Africa. Kibeho itself was the site of massacres in 1994 and of a camp where many displaced people were killed in 1995. It is now a pilgrimage site of the Catholic Church in Rwanda.
sum: Our Lady of Kibeho is the name given to apparitions of the Virgin Mary reported by schoolgirls at a Catholic school in Kibeho, southern Rwanda, beginning on 28 November 1981.
